name: Stripe Agent Toolkit
summary: Stripe's tools for letting agents operate a Stripe account: a hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com plus open-source SDKs (now in the stripe/ai repo). Agents can search the API, read and write Stripe objects, and search docs; some writes such as refunds need human confirmation.
facts: https://mcp.stripe.com, OAuth or agent API keys
API search/read/write, account info, docs search, analytics
Human confirmation for refunds and outbound payments
goodFor: Agents that run billing, refunds or support on your own Stripe account
watchOut: Stripe MCP stops accepting secret and non-agent restricted keys after 2026-11-30
Write access to a live account is powerful; scope keys tightly
